# Come Get This Junk

> Fast, friendly junk removal in the San Fernando Valley and Los Angeles. Text a photo for an upfront price; same-day or next-day haul-away.

Julian Hardee Services operates as Come Get This Junk. Primary contact: SMS or call 747-319-6969.

## Pages

- [Home — junk removal in the San Fernando Valley](https://comegetthisjunk.com/): Services, pricing flow, service promise, FAQ, and areas served.
- [Woodland Hills junk removal](https://comegetthisjunk.com/woodland-hills/): Hillside homes and Warner Center condos.
- [Tarzana junk removal](https://comegetthisjunk.com/tarzana/): Ranch-house garages, Ventura corridor, hillside access.
- [Reseda junk removal](https://comegetthisjunk.com/reseda/): Houses and apartment move-outs off Sherman Way and Reseda Boulevard.
- [Encino junk removal](https://comegetthisjunk.com/encino/): Ventura Boulevard condos and hillside houses south of the boulevard.
- [Sherman Oaks junk removal](https://comegetthisjunk.com/sherman-oaks/): Hillside houses south of Ventura and apartment jobs to the north.

## How to hire

1. Text a photo of the junk pile to 747-319-6969.
2. Receive an upfront price (large or complex jobs may need an in-person look the same day).
3. Schedule haul-away — usually same day or next day.

## Service area

Woodland Hills, Tarzana, Reseda, Encino, Sherman Oaks, and surrounding San Fernando Valley neighborhoods.
